description: Export a full GTM workspace summary as structured JSON. Returns all tags, triggers, variables, folders, and built-in variables. This is a read-only operation. Use this for documentation, auditing, or feeding container data to other tools.

format.description: "full" = all fields, "summary" = key fields only, "names_only" = just names and IDs

maxPages.description: Maximum API pages to fetch PER collection (default 50); the five collections are paged independently, so maxPages:2 costs up to 10 API pages. If more remain, the export is marked incomplete:true with truncatedCollections and per-collection nextPageTokens.

name: export_container
